State what remains trusted after this stage: which obligations are discharged, which are declared and unproved, and which rest on a named assumption. blocks is a liveness claim and this project proves no liveness. Handler atomicity is a platform assumption. The crash model is a per-device input. Each gets written where a reader meets it, not in an appendix.

```day-atom
{"in":["gate-result"],"out":["trust-statement"],"next":["upstream-file"]}
```

TRUST-STATEMENT for the RFC-6 anchor, written as a Residual trust section in the proposal itself - RFC-6 revision 3, commit 2720eaa3 on rfc/full-words - because that is where a reviewer looks and telos/residual-trust-is-named asks the stage to shrink its own claim visibly. Eight items, each naming what the evidence does NOT reach. The tooling that measured scope had four silent gaps and the correction came from the same class of instrument, so what backs the migration is the AST comparison rather than the counters; a fifth gap of the same shape would be equally silent. That comparison establishes SHAPE across the populations actually run, not agreement between the two front ends on every program. The test control is by failing-test NAME, and the 48 failing on both sides are evidence for nothing - a real regression hiding behind an environmental failure would be invisible to it. Untouched goldens show lowering did not change, not that it is correct. 43 declined clause-bearing literals rest on a person having read the list. 30 v2 comment lines survive inside migrated programs because no gate reads comment text. Five document populations keep the old spelling deliberately. The AST still speaks the old vocabulary, so keyword_kind maps keeps to TokKind::Inv, which RFC-17 proposes closing. The eighth is about our own process and is the one I would least like a reviewer to find unaided: 74 design-doc pins were moved across four waves today and NONE of those documents was re-read - every re-pin reasons from the diff rather than from re-auditing the document against its governed code. That is the largest unaudited surface the change ships, it is a property of how content pins are used rather than of this migration, and RFC-16 is the response.
